tool: Siril 1.4.4 seqstat (main) over `convert -debayer` of this session's own darks
what: the sensor PEDESTAL in the same units and the same debayered domain as the lights' register-regdata background, so `sky = bg - pedestal` is valid
why_it_matters: bg reads ~1058 ADU on a clear frame and the pedestal is ~1007, so the SKY is only ~50 ADU. A background change quoted as a fraction of bg understates it by ~21x: the set-01 cloud event is +0.5% of bg and +10% of sky.

frames.exif: NIKON Z6_3 / 2.5 s / ISO 1600 — matched to the lights
frames.sampling: 4 from the pre-lights block (DSC_2076-2226), 4 from the post-lights block (DSC_5255-5405)

stability_across_the_session.reading: the pedestal moved 0.09 ADU between the darks shot before the lights and those shot after, against sky changes of 3-70 ADU — so every background change measured in the lights is SKY, not sensor drift. This is the control that makes the sky numbers mean anything.

limits: per-frame medians are integer-quantised (16-bit data); the means above average 8 frames to recover sub-ADU precision
dark CURRENT at 2.5 s is not separated from the offset here — the figure is the combined zero-light level, which is exactly what `bg - pedestal` needs
